choices.choice: animate_image direct loose-sprite animation, proposed bounded motion experiment
choices.why: Official retained declaration explicitly supports a fresh first-frame PNG and four generated frames from a16x16 loose sprite. It does not require inventing a character/object resource. Current preparation uses accepted seed bytes, never old transport handles. Four distinct quarter-turn phases express an expert attempt to reduce prior model morph/holds, without adding exact geometry to owner rejection criteria.
choices.risk: Prior AI animation returned a grey matte and after guarded cutout still morphed/held and jumped at wrap; exact specialist-constructed quarter-turn motion subsequently passed. Thus this proposed AI retry is lower confidence than deterministic construction and no better outcome is claimed. Retained workbench declaration exposes guarded edits but no verified direct seed-to-four-frame rotation command; do not invent unsupported recipe fields. A future deterministic route should discover the full scene/animation contract first, retain fresh source input and provenance, and undergo independent review.
